notes.title: Walking In The Abyss: Definitive Edition - Major Update Notes
notes.notes:
I am thrilled to present the definitive edition of Walking In The Abyss! This update brings a range of improvements and new features to enhance your terrifying experience:

New Engine: The game has been migrated from RPG Maker VX Ace to RPG Maker MZ, ensuring better performance and new functionalities.
Remastered Textures: Now with high-resolution graphics for a sharper visual experience.
Screen Options: Choose between fullscreen or windowed mode directly from the menu.
Repositioned Items: Some items have been moved on the map to improve gameplay flow.
New Main Menu: Redesigned background art for a more immersive look.
Spanish Language: Play in Spanish! The language can be changed at any time during gameplay.
Customizable Window Mode: Resize the game window to your preference.
Audio Controls: Adjust individual volumes for music, effects, and other sounds in the options menu.
Updated Faces: Some characters now have updated faces in dialogue boxes and during gameplay.
Mouse Compatibility: You can now navigate the menu using the mouse.

Thank you for your continued support! I can't wait for you to experience the improvements in this definitive edition.

The Abyss awaits you!

notes.title: WITA v2.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
It is with great excitement that I announce the new update for your journey into the macabre world of "Walking in the Abyss." Check out the key changes below:

[olist]
 New Accessible Areas:
Explore uncharted territories as you unravel deeper secrets of the abyss.

 New Endings for Jack's Story Conclusion:
Jack's narrative unfolds with new twists and multiple endings. Your choices will shape his destiny, providing distinct experiences for players.

 New Steam Achievements:
Unlock new achievements as you face additional challenges and explore the newly available areas.

 Removal of the Gold Window in the Start Menu:
Simplified start menu interface without the gold window, offering a cleaner and narrative-focused experience.

 Enhanced Controls:
Players can now use both arrow keys and WASD for character control, providing greater flexibility and comfort.

 Tutorial on Acquiring the First Item:
Clear information on how to view item details in the menu upon acquiring the first item in the game.

 Facial Graphics Update:
Some graphical improvements have been made to facial expressions for characters.
[/olist]

Thank you for your dedication to exploring the depths of the abyss. I hope these additions further enrich your journey. Good luck, the darkness awaits!

notes.notes:
A bug was fixed

notes.title: Small update - November 03
notes.notes:
Minor changes were implemented in the game and a bug fixed.

Tutorial Update

 Added to the tutorial text the SPACE key as an alternative to ENTER.


New Scenario Interaction

 There is a new interaction in the dorms, with the book next to the piano.


Bug Fixed

 A bug that caused the game to crash when trying to move the dorm box while on its movement path has been fixed.
